story: Is Java more secure than C?
text: Yeah, I should have let the "just" out. There are a whole class of errors caused by C's memory corruption "feature" that I can happily live without. C tosses safety away, because its designers were lazy to implement a proper compiler given what the computing world was doing outside AT&T. Bjarne wasn't also quite found of it, but he had to compromise to get adoption, given his employer. [VIDEO]

It is, after being forced to use BCPL to finish his PhD and being used to languages like Simula, Bjarne swore he wouldn't be doing that again. Hence why he started to design C with Classes after getting his job at AT&T. [VIDEO] Around 29:00.

In "Oral History of Bjarne Stroustrup" Bjarne describes his goal for C++, which was abstractions with zero runtime cost : [VIDEO] I understand Rust is fast, but how does it do with complex abstractions?
Stroustrup once told about how he needed the best of both C and Simula, which resulted in creating C++. Full interview: [VIDEO]
